newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota Twins seek state investment in new park.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota Twins seek state investment in new park.

text.p: The Pohlad family, owners of the Minnesota Twins baseball team, Wednesday proposed an agreement that will keep the team in Minnesota and give the state a 49 percent stake in club.

The package calls for the Twins to contribute more than $157.5 million toward the construction of a new ballpark, baseball team officials said. The State of Minnesota will receive a 49 percent stake in the team in exchange for "assistance" on stadium financing, and the Twins will sign a 30-year lease at the new stadium.
The Pohlads would also be responsible for funding 100 percent of any operating losses the team may incur, not the State of Minnesota.
Negotiations are under way to define the type and amount of state investment that would be used to help finance the stadium project, Twins officials.
